rules: Each value retains its native system boundary and evidence class.
Cell PCE is not array specific power or deployed plant efficiency.
Programme goals and design targets are not achieved hardware results.
Published experimental results are not space-qualified or lunar-qualified unless the source says so.
Unknown values are omitted, never inferred from a nearby metric.

metrics.boundary: One PV/T configuration summarized by the 2026 lunar energy infrastructure review; review-reported, source-specific study metric
caveats: Approximate result from one cited configuration; not a universal PV/T gain or a lunar field demonstration.
Retrieve the primary study and reproduce its numerator, denominator, temperature grade, irradiance and useful-heat boundary before comparison.

metrics.boundary: RFC technology range summarized by the 2026 lunar energy infrastructure review; system boundary requires primary-source verification
caveats: Not an independently verified complete lunar-installed-system value.
Confirm whether tanks, insulation, electrolyzer, fuel cell, fluid, thermal management, controls and service life are included.
The review notes unresolved durability and long-duration lunar operation.

metrics.boundary: Experimental halide-perovskite cell on 2-mm anorthositic-regolith-derived moonglass, superstrate configuration
caveats: Research cell, not module or deployed array; performance is limited by moonglass optical absorption and contact resistance.

metrics.boundary: Experimental perovskite cell on anorthositic-regolith-derived moonglass using IZO substrate configuration
caveats: Research cell result; contact layers were not fully optimized and it is not a module or lunar-qualified product.

metrics.boundary: Moonglass-based perovskite cell after exposure to 2 × 10^12 68-MeV protons/cm²
caveats: Specific irradiation species, energy and dose; not a complete lunar radiation lifetime or operational stability qualification.

metrics.boundary: Modelled projection for approximately 0.1-mm moonglass and improved transport layers/interfaces
caveats: Simulated/projected performance, not an experimentally demonstrated device.

metrics.boundary: Study's proposed lunar manufacturing scenario comparing moonglass/perovskite with Earth-supplied conventional PV material transport
caveats: Author-reported scenario estimate; reproduce the imported-material inventory and include process equipment, tools, spares, deployment and lifetime replacement before using as a complete system result.

metrics.boundary: Study-calculated power-per-launched-mass ratio for its proposed lunar moonglass/perovskite concept
caveats: This is a launched-mass boundary estimate, not measured module/array W/kg or complete installed plant specific power.
The estimate depends on local regolith processing and imported precursor assumptions; do not compare directly with spacecraft-array W/kg without matching boundaries.
